services.name: Show Program
services.desc: The Chatham Community Players Joint Theater program provides independent study opportunities for Chatham High School students, providing hands on experience in the theater alongside professional and amateur crew and designers. It is a cooperative program with the school's theater department combining classroom knowledge with supervised practical theater experiences. Students assume leadership roles in stage management, sound, lights, costumes, props, stage crew, and acting, working with experienced committee heads and directors in a community theater setting.
